## Work Experience

### Pace University — Part-time Paid Research Assistant
*June 2024 – May 2026 | New York, NY*

- Analyzed the association between meditation practice and verbal fluency using 22 years of Health and Retirement Study (HRS) data from a national cohort of over 47,000 participants.
- Preprocessed longitudinal data in R and Stata, applying GLLAMM and augmented inverse probability weighting (AIPW) to estimate adjusted associations.
- Found that regular meditation was associated with 4.42-point (0.5 SD) higher verbal fluency among participants without baseline depressive symptoms (p = 0.015), with no significant association in the depressive-symptom subgroup.
- Contributed to statistical analysis and manuscript preparation as a co-author.
- Presented a research poster at the 2026 NYS Public Health Partnership Conference Student Poster Session.
